field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.order_delivery: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.
field_descriptions.order_item_number: The identifier of the order item.
field_descriptions.order_item_status: The current status of the order item.
field_descriptions.order_quantity: The number of the item ordered. If the property is not set, assume the quantity is one.
